description:
About Asteris
 Asteris is a leader in veterinary imaging technology. Our Keystone PACS software suite helps veterinary practices, hospitals, and specialists store, view, share, and report on diagnostic images, from radiographs to ultrasound and CT, easily and securely from anywhere. Built specifically for the veterinary industry, Keystone integrates with leading practice management systems and powers teleconsultation workflows that help veterinarians make confident medical decisions. Asteris is part of Valsoft Corporation, which acquires and grows vertical market software companies.
 The Role
 As a Software Developer on the Asteris team, you will help build and evolve Keystone, our PACS platform for veterinary imaging. You will work on features that store, transfer, render, and share diagnostic images, and help deliver the reliability, performance, and integrations our clients rely on every day.
 What You'll Do
 Design, build, and maintain features across the Keystone PACS platform
 Work with DICOM data and imaging workflows, including storage, transfer, viewing, and reporting
 Build and support integrations with imaging modalities and practice management systems
 Design services with a strong focus on high availability, scalability, performance, and observability
 Take end-to-end ownership of the quality, testing, and production readiness of what you build
 Write clean, well-documented code and take part in code and design reviews
 Build prototypes and proofs of concept to evaluate new technologies
 Work with the Support team to identify and fix performance, scalability, and production issues
 Collaborate with Product and Support to translate client needs into solutions
 Requirements 
 What You Bring
 3+ years of professional software development experience
 Hands-on experience with medical imaging, PACS, and the DICOM standard
 Strong skills in a modern object-oriented language, such as C# / .NET or C++
 Experience with relational databases and SQL
 Solid understanding of networking and client/server architecture
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a remote team
 Nice to Have
 Experience with HL7 or healthcare integrations
 Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, and image storage at scale
 Experience with 3D rendering or advanced image viewers
 Benefits 
 What We Offer
 Competitive base salary
 Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, and vision, plus basic life, AD&D, short- and long-term disability, and voluntary life coverage
 401(k) program
 Unlimited paid time off
 Fully remote, work-from-home role
 The chance to make a real impact on a growing team in a specialized, mission-driven industry
